title: Best Refurbished Samsung Phones Under $300 in the USA (2026)
content_html:
A $300 budget is a search limit, not proof that every model below is currently available below it. This shortlist compares different Samsung phones and the checks that decide whether a refurbished offer is worth buying. The retailer links are searches, not verified in-stock offers at a quoted price.

Some links in this article are affiliate links.

Galaxy S23

The Galaxy S23 is a strong all-round target if you want flagship performance in a compact body. It is one of the first models we would search for in this price range.

Check current Galaxy S23 listings on eBay

Galaxy S22 Ultra

The S22 Ultra is worth considering if you want a larger display, S Pen support and a premium camera setup. Compare condition and storage carefully because prices can vary widely.

Check current Galaxy S22 Ultra listings on eBay

Galaxy S22

The standard S22 can be a good-value alternative if you want a premium Samsung phone but would rather spend less than the top of the budget.

Check current Galaxy S22 listings on eBay

Galaxy A54

The Galaxy A54 is a sensible choice if battery life, a large screen and everyday usability matter more than having an older flagship.

Check current Galaxy A54 listings on eBay

S23, S22 Ultra or A54: what changes your decision?

Samsung's US S23 specification sheet lists a 6.1-inch display and Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 for Galaxy processor. S23 specifications. Its compact format is a reason to compare it for everyday use; it is not evidence that a particular used battery or screen is in good condition. Check storage and the precise carrier model before treating two S23 offers as equivalent.

The S22 Ultra's 6.8-inch display and built-in S Pen make it a different physical choice. S22 Ultra specifications. Consider it when you will use the screen space and pen. Ask whether the S Pen is included, inspect screen photographs and check repair history. Choose a smaller model if pocket fit matters more; an Ultra badge does not make a missing pen or damaged display better value.

Samsung specifies a 6.4-inch display for the A54. A54 specifications. Compare it with the S-series choices on features you need and actual refurbishment terms. Do not assume a used A54 has longer battery life than a particular S23; age, replacement quality and settings matter. The standard S22 is worth comparing when its complete price is meaningfully lower than an equivalent S23, with software support and battery terms kept in the calculation.

What refurbished actually promises

A cosmetic grade and a manufacturer refurbishment program are different promises. Samsung describes a certified new battery and one-year limited manufacturer warranty for its own Certified Re-Newed phones. Samsung Certified Re-Newed terms. Do not transfer those benefits to an unrelated marketplace seller. Ask who refurbished the phone, what battery standard is guaranteed, which parts were changed and who handles a warranty claim. Read the written terms for the particular offer.

US carrier compatibility comes before price

Ask for the exact model code and the information your intended carrier needs to check compatibility. Samsung says outbound-carrier unlocking is required for its BYOD carrier-switching process and that unlock requirements are controlled by the carrier. Samsung US carrier-switching guidance. Confirm acceptance with your intended carrier before buying. A seller calling a phone unlocked does not settle every activation, financing or carrier-feature question. Ask that it is free of account locks, with a return route if that claim fails.

Support and battery terms matter as much as cosmetic grade

Check the exact device against Samsung's current security-update scope, then compare its installed software and patch date. Resale and a factory reset do not restart the manufacturer's support period. Distinguish a seller's minimum battery-capacity promise from a promise of a new battery. Ask for the test method and the remedy if it falls short. Words such as excellent or pristine do not answer those questions.

Compare the complete cost with your $300 limit

A hypothetical $250 phone plus $20 delivery and $20 of required charging equipment totals $290 before applicable sales tax. Those are example figures, not live offers. Add costs for your selected listing and check who pays return shipping. A higher-priced offer may be better value when its battery, warranty and returns are documented; a cheaper offer may make sense when the same protections are included.

A five-minute arrival check

Before moving your accounts, confirm the received model and storage match the order and carrier activation works. Inspect the screen on a plain background, test charging and ports, make a call, and try the cameras, speakers, microphones and any supplied S Pen. Photograph discrepancies and contact the seller within the return window. These checks do not prove long-term reliability or restored water resistance.

For a separate larger-screen device, compare our refurbished iPad guide. The USA tech hub links related buying decisions.

Guide updated September 2026. Prices and availability change regularly.
